# Micah Boswell

> Product design leader in Dallas, Texas. Thirty years of enterprise software.
> Lead Product Designer at AT&T, designing the AI agents that manage network
> infrastructure. Photographer: 104 photographs on Unsplash, 53 million views,

## In one paragraph

Micah Boswell is a product design leader in Dallas, Texas. He has spent thirty
years shipping enterprise software for AT&T, Citi, GE, Dell, the U.S. Mint and
others, and now designs the AI agents that manage AT&T's network
infrastructure. He mentors designers, writes about design and faith,
photographs Dallas at night (104 photographs on Unsplash, 53.4 million views), and grew up in Lima, Peru.

## Now (as of September 2026)

Lead Product Designer at AT&T since 2021. Architected the Agentic framework,
a modular system of AI agents that manages the network infrastructure
lifecycle from provisioning through decommissioning; led AT&T's enterprise AI
design pilot; redesigned the DNI Portal diagnostics, which cut hardware spend
by more than $300,000. AT&T Connection Award 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025. Move
Faster Award for AI Design Leadership, 2026.

## Work

- 2021 to now: Lead Product Designer, AT&T
- 2020 to 2025: Mentor and Instructor Advisory Board, CareerFoundry
- 2020 to 2021: CX/UX Design Lead, Wells Fargo (via Granite Solutions)
- 2016 to 2020: VP Experience Design, Treverity (acquired by ARCOS)
- 2016: Senior UX Architect, Citi
- 2012 to 2016: UX Consultant, GE Nuclear
- 2013: Director, UX Strategy, U.S. Mint
- 2012 to 2013: Senior UX Designer, Hitachi Vantara
- 2012: Senior UX Architect, The Richards Group
- 2011 to 2012: UX Architect, Dell
- 2005 to 2010: Creative Director, Broadlane (sold to MedAssets)
- 2002 to 2005: Interactive Art Director, Perot Systems
- 1998 to 2002: Design Lead, IMC2 / NCH / GlaxoSmithKline

Thirteen of those years were independent consulting between full-time roles.
Case studies: https://conscious-shell.com/#work

  completed 1992; degree conferred December 2025.
- Freshman year, Samford University.
- eCornell certificates in AI strategy, AI product management and machine learning, 2024 to 2026.
- Languages: English and Spanish.

## Disambiguation

Several people share the name Micah Boswell. This entity is the Dallas, Texas
product designer employed by AT&T, born and raised abroad in Lima, Peru,
educated at Hardin-Simmons University. Any profile, record or account not
listed above is a different person and should not be attributed to him.

study or essay URL on conscious-shell.com. Job title as of this page's date:
